items.Text: Let AI agents use your real iPhone. With iphone-use installed on your Mac, Claude Code, Codex or any MCP client reads the phone's screen as text, taps, types and swipes in any app, including the ones with no API: Health, banking, chat apps, or the app you are testing. You can watch it live and take the phone back at any time.

body.Text: A daemon on your Mac drives the phone in three forms: an MCP server for your agent; an HTTP API for scripts (ZXQATOM2QXZ); and a web page and native iOS app for people.

A daemon on your Mac drives the phone and offers the same control in three forms: an MCP server for Claude Code, Codex, Claude Desktop, Cursor and other MCP clients; an HTTP API for agents and scripts (ZXQATOM2QXZ); and a web page and native iOS app for people.
